items.title: Kioxia CD9P 7.68TB E3.S NVMe SSD Review Fast Gen5 Storage
items.snippet: The Kioxia CD9P is the company’s latest PCIe Gen5 family of data center SSDs. Today, we are going to get into the E3.S version and, more specifically, a 7.68TB CD9P-R model. That “-R” tells us we have the read-intensive version at 1DWPD for 5 years. There is also a “-V” mixed-use variant that uses more spare capacity to absorb a 3 DWPD cycle, but lowers capacity to only 6.4TB. Still, we wanted to see what this drive can do. The first thing you will immediately notice is that this is not a U.2 drive. Instead, you can see that we have an E3.S form factor NVMe SSD. That E3.S form factor allows for higher storage density, as we saw in our Dell PowerEdge R670 1U server review. The form factor allows thin carrier trays to be attached, thereby enabling that density. Perhaps the biggest change is the connector, which is still a PCIe Gen5 x4 connector, but it is also much smaller, helping cooling and signal integrity.
